newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa names American to head new unit.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa names American to head new unit.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Monday it had named Frederick Reid to head up its scheduled airline passenger unit which is due to come into being from April this year.

Lufthansa said Reid, 46, would also be in charge of marketing and network management operations in the new unit. Before moving to Lufthansa in 1991, Reid worked at Pan American Airlines and for American Airlines.

The German flag carrier said last week it would be grouping its passenger services activities into one division and streamlining its management in a move ahead of full liberalisation of European aviation markets later this year.
